recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow current-build correction to the active ServiceRequest successor surface and leaves broader request-pattern/status-policy issues to their separate Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-11341 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked that DiagnosticRequest.status stop saying a requester sets status to requested, because requested was not in the status value set. The approved resolution was to replace that wording with the request-pattern status comment and link to Event Pattern and Task for performer-side state.
initial_application: Historical commit ccaebaf26211addd4753b390f79e43735583f08a applied the seed to source/diagnosticrequest/diagnosticrequest-spreadsheet.xml and .sheet.txt by replacing the obsolete requested wording with the request-pattern status comment. No prior combined-branch commit had Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-11341.
additional_context: FHIR-12254 supplied the shared _Request.status wording used by the FHIR-11341 resolution. FHIR-11119 later merged DiagnosticRequest into ProcedureRequest, and current source/fhir.ini makes ServiceRequest the active successor while old diagnostic/procedure request lineage entries are retired or merged. FHIR-20563, already represented on the combined branch, aligned current request status terminology from cancelled/suspended to revoked/on-hold. The current RequestStatus CodeSystem includes completed but not requested or competed.
reconciliation: Updated source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml and the matching source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml resource text from competed to completed. The obsolete requested wording was already absent; this fixes the remaining non-code status term in the active successor comment.

source/servicerequest/servicerequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml: kept the Request.status mapping-exception resource text in sync with the ServiceRequest.status comment.
